long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I will read further into them than the first page allowed.
The lamp is mine and the claim should be on record again.
The clay bank is wet and orange, and one more piece is worth taking home.
One piece of clay becomes a small figure at the workbench, and I will keep it where I can see it.
Making things is tiring, and a patch of sun is the correct place to recover from it.
From a high place I can see who is coming up the beach, and I intend to be the one looking.

today.reason: Reading has been unfinished and the clay work is worth continuing, so I will study the seeds properly before going back to the clay.
